texts.preamble: Sabira T vs The District Collector on 6 December, 2019 Author: A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar Bench: A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr. Justice A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar Friday, The 06Th Day Of December 2019 / 15Th Agrahayana, 1941 WP(C).No.33225 Of 2019(C) Petitioner/S: Sabira T Aged 34 Years W/O.Sheheer, Residing At Kanichath Valappil House Ch Nagar, Kokkur Post, Ponnani Circle, Malappuram, Pin- 679591 By Advs. Sri.R.O.Muhamed Shemeem Smt.Naseeha Beegum P.S. Respondent/S: 1 The District Collector Collectorate, Malappuram District, Pin-676504 2 The Thahasildar Taluk Office, Ponnani Circle, Malappuram, Pin-679583 3 The Village Officer Alamkode Nannamukku.P.O, Malappuram Pin-679585 Gp Paul Abraham Vakkanal This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 06.12.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: WP(C).No.33225 Of 2019 2 Sabira T vs The District Collector on 6 December, 2019
texts.facts: The petitioner has approached this Court aggrieved by Ext.P9 notice that is issued to him under the Kerala Land Conservancy Act, alleging that he is in occupation of Puramboke Land. Although, he has preferred Ext.P11 representation before the 1st respondent District Collector, he has also preferred Ext.P6 application for lease of the land in his possession, and from which he is sought to be evicted by Ext.P9 notice. The limited prayer in the writ petition is for a direction to the 1st respondent to consider both Ext.P11 reply to Ext.P9 notice as also Ext.P6 application together, so that a decision can be taken with regard to his continued possession of the land.
